purpose: Refresh the baseline snapshot to the current main-branch registry, adapters, workflows, ruleset manifest and read-only owner configuration after capability inventory drift controls were merged.

compatibility.rule: A task may run only when its pinned registry, adapter, workflow, review-engine, and config-baseline versions satisfy an explicitly validated compatibility contract.

known_gaps: Capability inventory freshness is now machine-checked, but complete runtime input/output contracts and typed dependency edges remain incomplete for most Python components.
Write-path ownership and indirect side effects still require machine-checked coverage across all independent writers.
The source-assessment adapter remains disabled in main; its one-shot canary used a temporary runner-local override and does not authorize general dispatch.
The declared review-engine version is not yet pinned to a verified source revision.
Durable failed-run cursor persistence is deferred until a Watchdog-leased capability owns that write.

required_before_independent_python_dispa: Validate executable entrypoints and argument schemas.
Declare read and write resource sets, including indirect writes.
Enforce exclusive resource leases for overlapping writers.
Record input snapshot hashes and output artifact hashes.
Verify config-baseline immutability before and after execution.
Run isolated canary tests with all new adapters disabled by default.
